planBudget.title: Plan & budget
planBudget.subtitle: Used to compute API-equivalent value and the burn-rate forecast on Insights.
planBudget.monthlyPlanPriceHint: What you actually pay — used for the "value vs plan" comparison.
planBudget.monthlyBudgetHint: Drives the budget bar and forecast warning on Insights.
planBudget.contextAlertThresholdHint: Notify when a session's context high-water mark crosses this share of its model's window.
planBudget.invalidNumber: Enter a number of 0 or more.

dailySpendAlert.title: Daily spend alert
dailySpendAlert.subtitle: A pop-up from the menu-bar icon when today's spend crosses your limits. Days follow your time zone.
dailySpendAlert.enabledHint: Shown under the menu-bar icon, not as a system notification. Each level fires once per day.
dailySpendAlert.dailyBudgetHint: The 100% level. Set to 0 to turn the alert off.
dailySpendAlert.warnAtHint: Warn once today's spend reaches this share of the daily budget.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.contextAlertsHint: OS notification + in-app banner when a session crosses the threshold above.
notifications.dailyDigestHint: A quiet, once-a-day summary — no push during active work.
notifications.budgetWarningsHint: Notify at 80% and 100% of the monthly budget above.

logsDirectory.title: Logs directory
logsDirectory.subtitle: Arlo reads Claude Code and Codex CLI logs from these folders — nothing leaves your machine.
logsDirectory.sampleDescription: Show generated example sessions instead of your logs.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Read-only. Rates are keyed to when each request happened, not the rate in effect today.
pricing.footerNote: Rates are per million tokens ($/Mtok) as published by Anthropic. Cache write 1h is charged at the same rate as cache write 5m. Actual costs may vary; check anthropic.com/pricing for the latest rates.
pricing.unpricedWarning: Pricing not found for {{models}}. Set a price for them under Models in your data.

online.label: Update model prices online
online.hint: Once a day, downloads the public price list for models not in the table below. Nothing about your usage is sent.
online.off: Off — using the prices built into the app

used.title: Models in your data
used.hint: Every model your sessions use and where its price comes from. Set your own price for models nothing else prices — self-hosted, custom deployments, routers.

database.title: Local database
database.subtitle: Arlo caches session totals in a local SQLite file. Everything in it is recomputed from your transcripts — resetting loses nothing.
database.detail: Clears the cache and rebuilds it from {{path}}. Use it to drop sessions whose transcripts you deleted, or to re-apply pricing and parser changes.

tray.heading: Arlo · Today
tray.alertOff: Daily spend alert is off. Set a daily budget to get a pop-up here.

dataAccess.connectedNoSessions: {{tool}} folder connected — no sessions found yet.
dataAccess.sampleBannerBody: These sessions are generated examples. Connect your own logs to see your real usage.
dataAccess.welcomeBody: Arlo shows what your AI coding tools use and cost, straight from the logs they keep on this Mac. Allow read-only access to get started — nothing leaves your machine.
dataAccess.sourcesLabel: AI coding tools on this Mac
dataAccess.hint: macOS asks you to confirm each folder. It opens in the right place — just click Open.
dataAccess.noneFound: No Claude Code or Codex CLI logs were found on this Mac. Choose a folder if you keep them elsewhere, or look around with sample data.

card.title: Plan usage
card.subtitle: How much of each subscription's current limits is used.
card.noQuota: No limits recorded yet — they appear after the next request.
card.turnOnLive: Turn on online checks in Settings to see these limits.

settings.title: Plans & limits
settings.subtitle: Read from each tool's own sign-in on this Mac. Nothing is sent anywhere unless online checks are on.
settings.none: No Claude Code or Codex CLI installation found on this Mac.

online.label: Check plan limits online
online.hint: Asks Anthropic or OpenAI for current usage with the tool's own sign-in — the same request its /usage or /status makes. Each token goes only to that tool's vendor, and is never renewed or stored by this app. Codex limits are also read from its logs without this.
online.off: Off — showing only what is on this Mac

source.logs: Plan read from the tool's logs

issue.credentials_unreadable: Couldn't read this tool's sign-in. The Keychain may have refused, or — in the App Store version — the folder chosen under Logs directory doesn't include it (choose ~/.claude or ~/.codex itself).
issue.sign_in_expired: The saved sign-in has expired. Run the tool once to renew it.
issue.no_usage_access: This sign-in is a long-lived token that can't report plan limits. Sign in with /login to see them.
issue.unauthorized: The vendor rejected the saved sign-in. Sign in to the tool again.
issue.rate_limited: Checked too often — the vendor asked to wait. Trying again later.
issue.failed: Couldn't get current limits from the vendor.
